crime_highlights: While all three teenagers were on the bed, the gunman produced the gun
The gunman opened fire at the three teenagers on the bed
She was shot twice, taking bullets to the top of her neck
The damage to her spinal cord has left her permanently paralyzed
rationale_highlights: D.(R.)’s moral culpability and his rehabilitation and reintegration must be examined through the lens of his racialization and his experiences as a member of a community where criminal activity has been, to some extent, normalized for him
He too was struggling as a racialized teen in the conflicted dimensions of his existence
Understanding this context matters in the sentencing exercise but it does not lead me to conclude that D.(R.) should serve no further time in custody
note: Court says context matters but imposes same sentence as co-accused; no stated reduction.

the officers who stopped Mr. Denny believed that his ability to drive was impaired by alcohol and made breath demands
rationale_highlights: In many respects, Mr. Denny’s personal history reflects the fallout from that historical injustice and the court must take that into account in imposing a sentence here today
it is also imperative morally and normatively that I consider this
Mr. Denny, due to personal circumstances which include the oppressive circumstances of his First-Nations’ history, experienced a lapse in his success in dealing with an alcohol-use disorder

crime_highlights: Mr. Power raced forward with Mr. Gannon and they each punched Mr. Ward in the area of his face, which knocked Mr. Ward to the ground
Mr. Power remained on top of him and punched him two or three more times
Mr. Power casually walked away from the victim who was lying on the pavement motionless and unconscious
Mr. Power acknowledges that Mr. Ward was beaten into unconsciousness by himself, Mr. Brushett and Mr. Gannon
they found Mr. Ward laying on the ground, unconscious, bleeding from his nose and mouth
rationale_highlights: Tyler Power has personally experienced the adverse impact of many factors continuing to plague Aboriginal communities since colonization
taking into account the Gladue factors which may have contributed to these charges, I am prepared to order a sentence at the lower end of that range
note: Court also lists Gladue factors as mitigating moral culpability in para 27.
